description: Two-page Simplified Chinese quotation for office-equipment maintenance (fictitious companies, models and prices) with English phrases and a price table, written from scratch in both versions with PyMuPDF 2.1 insert_htmlbox (MuPDF Story HTML/CSS layout; WenQuanYi Zen Hei embedded via @font-face; each page is its own htmlbox, so text re-flows within a page but never across pages). Both versions are regenerated from edited HTML, so every edit is a content-stream edit; there are no annotations. Edits: validity date, inspection frequency, on-site response hours, an English phrase extended, underline added to the late-payment clause, list item 3 deleted, a new last list item, and a paragraph moved from p. 2 (section 5) to p. 1 (end of section 1). Consequences, not listed: the rest of p. 1 re-flows downwards; the ordered list renumbers automatically (item 4 becomes 3); p. 2 closes the gap left by the moved paragraph.

truth.note: Validity date: month 11 -> 12 and day 30 -> 31 in one date; may be listed as one or two number changes.
Inspection frequency quarterly -> monthly (每季度 -> 每月).
On-site response time 4 -> 6 hours; the 2-hour phone response before it is unchanged.
English sentence inside Chinese text: 'available in English on weekdays' -> 'available in English and Chinese on weekdays'.
